evidence: The controlling BCS-58 design and current plan-spec both require the numerical-optimization-for-statistical-computation page. I inspected its current A-page summary and actual alg-gradient-descent and alg-damped-newton definitions. They specify procedures but explicitly make no global optimizer-convergence claim. The binding target here is an exact argmin definition with a local existence/tie-break proof; no convergence property of either optimizer is imported. This is a page-level prerequisite, not an item edge.

The controlling BCS-58 design and current plan-spec both require the IID Monte Carlo page. I inspected its current A-page summary, the actual def-iid-monte-carlo-estimators definition and proof suppliers, and the current IID Monte Carlo item readiness record. This authoring uses the published general IID definition and states the vector sample mean and covariance formulas locally, so no batch-28 item theorem is imported. The upstream page-level prerequisite remains by plan; its current interface is draft content with Step-1 authoring readiness, not independent acceptance.
